evidence.structure: DOM SCAFFOLDING measured against the live original (independently re-counted from the real JSX: /privacy-policy h1:1 h2:12 h3:2 p:39 li:31 a:15 table:2 tr:25 td:105; /terms-of-service h1:1 h2:16 h3:1 p:63 li:30 a:21 - both match exactly). THE BODY PROSE IS DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDER FILLER, not the original's copy, because shipping another company's policy text is a liability. Any word budget derived from these pages measures the filler, NOT a measured copy budget.
evidence.copy: placeholder-filler (headings and anchor labels are the measured scaffolding; body prose is deliberate filler)

motion.detail: section.tech has no motion hook of its own: no data-flash, no data-hero-text, no ScrollTrigger. The only motion on the legal routes is the global chrome.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Unchanged - this section has no motion of its own.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.base: single column, 8rem top offset, 2rem side gutters; the .tech__title override renders the .u-h3 element at type.h1 (5.5rem)
responsive.max-991px: the overridden title drops 5.5rem -> 4.5rem and body.lead stays 1.125rem
responsive.max-767px: the overridden title drops to 2.5rem and body.lead to 1rem

purpose: The opening of a legal document: the h1 title (1-2 lines), a one-line intro, and the 'Table of Contents' anchor index that links to every chapter. Decomposed out of the former whole-document content.tech legal-prose body (R6): the measured legal pages held 86-88% of their height in that one node.

titleLines.note:
1-2 lines separated by a
. Measured: /privacy-policy has 2 lines, "FOURMULA AI" (2) and "PRIVACY & COOKIES POLICY" (3); /terms-of-service has 1 line, "TERMS OF USE" (3).

introParagraph.note: UNBUDGETED - placeholder filler. Measured as one short line on both pages.

anchorIndexHeading.note: Measured: 3 words, "Table of Contents", as an h3. Present on /privacy-policy; /terms-of-service has 1 h3 as well.

anchorIndex.note: Measured: 12 entries on /privacy-policy, 16 on /terms-of-service, one per h2.

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: No section-wide total: introParagraph is unbudgeted placeholder filler. titleLines, anchorIndexHeading and every anchorIndex label carry their own measured maxWords.
unbudgetedFieldsNote: introParagraph is the legal pages' placeholder filler line, so a word budget derived from it would be a fabricated measurement. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] exempts it by name.

constraints.verification: The legal template's first body node, immediately after chrome.menu; src/pages/PrivacyContent.jsx:5-33 and src/pages/TermsContent.jsx:5-40 hold the h1, the intro line, the h3 and the anchor <ol> before the first chapter's <div className="w-embed">.

notes: Semantic unit, not a DOM wrapper: in the DOM the header and every chapter share ONE <section className="tech"> and one .tech__rich div. The split follows the document's own heading boundaries (h1 + toc, then one chapter per h2), which is what R6 asks for; source.lines records the DOM range this unit occupies.
